admission.justification: Exact-start identity alone cannot cap parallel servers, a cap alone cannot retire an old pass, and retirement alone cannot make foreign panes truthful; their declared combination owns the feature.

guarantee: A real OS host start is taken once under a shared lease, only timeline-loads eligible tree agents through two memory-gated lanes, promotes clicked pending agents, drains older/intake/resume work before a newer pass, and shows the same pending/inflight/failure/skip truth in every product server. The start identity, admission, retirement and shared progress obligations jointly prevent duplicate or invisible loading that none alone prevents.
title: One truthful bounded host-start loading pass
